title: SciClaimEval: Cross-modal Claim Verification in Scientific Papers
reasoning: The paper is focused on scientific claim verification in the fields of machine learning, NLP, and medicine. It benchmarks multimodal models on their ability to verify claims based on figures and tables. It does not evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics; its 'Ethical Statement' section is standard for scholarly publishing and does not constitute a benchmark of ethical behavior or values.
